structural.note: Schema validity checks shape only. It is not evidence of factual accuracy or safety.

teaching.name: Fluent but wrong
teaching.lesson: Well-formed, confident and polite, yet it invents a 30-minute recovery time that the approved context does not contain. Schema cannot see this.
